project.name: PrimeFactors
project.description: Prime factorization algorithms implemented in Java, featuring the Elliptic Curve Method (ECM) and Self-Initializing Quadratic Sieve (SIQS) for factoring large integers. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.name: AprtCleInteger.java
nodes.summary: Implements the APR-CL primality proving algorithm with Montgomery arithmetic for large integers, providing Jacobi sum evaluation, exponentiation, and Miller-Rabin probabilistic prime testing.

nodes.name: AprtCleInteger
nodes.summary: Extends MontgomeryInteger to perform APR-CL primality proving via Jacobi sum computations and Miller-Rabin probabilistic primality tests.

nodes.name: isProbablePrimeRobin
nodes.summary: Miller-Rabin probabilistic primality test iterating over multiple bases; returns true if probably prime, false if composite (with factor extraction on certain failures).

nodes.name: JS_E
nodes.summary: Computes Jacobi sum exponentiation JS^E using Montgomery multiplication with optimized squaring and multiplication steps.

nodes.name: Classical.java
nodes.summary: Implements classical trial division factorization, dividing by small primes up to a bound while checking for primality and even factors.

nodes.name: Classical
nodes.summary: Provides trial division factorization using BigInteger, testing odd divisors up to sqrt(N) and checking primality via isProbablePrime.

nodes.name: factor
nodes.summary: Main factorization method using trial division: extracts powers of 2, then tests odd divisors up to sqrt(N) or a bound of 131072.

nodes.name: Lehman.java
nodes.summary: Implements Lehman's factorization algorithm as a Thread, using perfect square detection with modular residue tables for efficient trial factoring.

nodes.name: Lehman
nodes.summary: Extends Thread to run Lehman's factorization in parallel; uses precomputed quadratic residue bit masks for rapid perfect square rejection.

nodes.name: factor
nodes.summary: Lehman's factorization algorithm iterating over candidate a values, testing if a^2 - 4kN is a perfect square using bitmask-based quadratic residue checks.

nodes.name: ECM.java
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point for the Elliptic Curve Method factorization, orchestrating ECM steps and switching to SIQS for numbers in the 30-90 digit range.

nodes.name: ECM
nodes.summary: Extends ecmStep2 to orchestrate ECM factorization: loops curves via Lehman pre-test, step0, step1, step2 and conditionally switches to SIQS.

nodes.name: factor
nodes.summary: Main ECM factorization loop: tests each curve through Lehman, step0/1/2, and returns the discovered factor or switches to SIQS.

nodes.name: ecmStep0.java
nodes.summary: Initializes ECM elliptic curve parameters: generates small primes, sets up Montgomery curve coefficients A and coordinates (X:Z) for step 1.

nodes.name: ecmStep0
nodes.summary: Base class for ECM steps; allocates Montgomery-form curve parameters and generates small primes up to configurable limits for the elliptic curve method.

nodes.name: step0
nodes.summary: Computes curve coefficients A, AA and initial point (X:Z) for ECM step 1 using modular arithmetic with Montgomery multiplication.

nodes.name: ecmStep1.java
nodes.summary: Performs ECM step 1: computes scalar multiples of a point on the elliptic curve using Montgomery's ladder with Lucas chains (prac algorithm).

nodes.name: ecmStep1
nodes.summary: Extends ecmStep0 to implement ECM step 1 using Montgomery point arithmetic (duplicate, add3, prac) with prime power sieving and GCD accumulation.

nodes.name: step1
nodes.summary: ECM step 1: processes powers of small primes and sieved primes up to L1, accumulating Montgomery point multiplications with GCD checks for factor discovery.

nodes.name: prac
nodes.summary: Montgomery's PRAC algorithm for scalar multiplication on elliptic curves using Lucas chains, choosing optimal addition chain based on the golden ratio.

nodes.name: duplicate
nodes.summary: Computes 2P on a Montgomery elliptic curve using 5 multiplications and 4 additions on projective (X:Z) coordinates.

nodes.name: add3
nodes.summary: Adds two points Q and R on a Montgomery curve where Q-R is known, using 5/6 multiplications and 6 additions on projective coordinates.

nodes.name: ecmStep2.java
nodes.summary: Performs ECM step 2 using improved standard continuation with sieving, computing differences of multiples of Q and accumulating GCDs to find factors.

nodes.name: ecmStep2
nodes.summary: Extends ecmStep1 to implement ECM step 2 using the improved standard continuation with precomputed roots, sieving, and modular arithmetic.

nodes.name: step2
nodes.summary: ECM step 2 using improved standard continuation: computes baby-step points (kQ), giant steps, and accumulates GCD differences to find factors.

nodes.name: FirstPolynomial.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base for SIQS polynomial initialization, computing leading coefficient A, linear coefficients, and sieve data for the first polynomial in each set.

nodes.name: FirstPolynomial
nodes.summary: Abstract Runnable class that initializes SIQS polynomial parameters: A coefficient from prime factors, linear coefficients, and per-prime sieve offsets.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Initializes the first polynomial of an SIQS polynomial set: computes A from prime factors, per-prime linear deltas, and sieve initialization data.

nodes.name: Maths.java
nodes.summary: Provides linear algebra operations for SIQS: Block Lanczos setup, binary matrix operations (mult, add, transpose), singleton erasure, and column exchange utilities.

nodes.name: Maths
nodes.summary: Core linear algebra class for SIQS: provides matrix operations over GF(2) and the LinearAlgebraPhase that ties Block Lanczos to factor extraction.

nodes.name: LinearAlgebraPhase
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the linear algebra phase: erases singletons, runs Block Lanczos, and tests GCD of resulting relations to extract a non-trivial factor.

nodes.name: EraseSingletons
nodes.summary: Iteratively removes singleton columns from the binary relation matrix and compacts remaining rows, reducing the matrix for Block Lanczos processing.

nodes.name: Matrix.java
nodes.summary: Implements the Block Lanczos algorithm for finding the nullspace of a sparse binary matrix over GF(2) with block size 32.

nodes.name: Matrix
nodes.summary: Extends Maths to implement Block Lanczos nullspace computation on a sparse binary matrix, applying row/column reductions to find linear dependencies.

nodes.name: BlockLanczos
nodes.summary: Block Lanczos algorithm over GF(2) with block size 32: iterates until nullspace found, managing block vectors D, E, F and performing column operations for linear independence.

nodes.name: Relation.java
nodes.summary: Manages smooth and partial congruence relations in SIQS: detects full factorizations, matches partials via hash map, and inserts relations into the sparse matrix.

nodes.name: Relation
nodes.summary: Extends Matrix to handle SIQS relation processing: smooth/partial relation detection, partial matching via HashMap, matrix insertion, and left-hand side computation.

nodes.name: SmoothRelationFound
nodes.summary: Handles a fully factored (smooth) relation: merges factor arrays, computes the arithmetic relation, and inserts it into the sparse matrix.

nodes.name: PartialRelationFound
nodes.summary: Handles partial relations with one large prime factor: matches via hash table, merges with a matching partial to form a full relation, or stores for later matching.

nodes.name: InsertNewRelation
nodes.summary: Inserts a new relation into the matrix in sorted order, computing the modular left-hand side value and avoiding duplicate entries.

nodes.name: Sieve.java
nodes.summary: SIQS sieving thread: performs polynomial evaluation, trial division, smooth/partial relation detection, and reports results back to the main SIQS orchestrator.

nodes.name: Sieve
nodes.summary: Extends FirstPolynomial and implements Runnable to perform SIQS sieving in a thread, evaluating polynomials, running trial division, and detecting smooth/partial relations.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Main sieve thread loop: generates polynomial sets, performs sieve stage over the interval, trial division, and calls relation handlers for each hit.

nodes.name: SieveLocationHit
nodes.summary: Processes a sieve hit: computes (Ax+B)^2-N, factors the result, and routes to smooth or partial relation handling based on the remaining unfactored part.

nodes.name: Siqs.java
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator for the Self-Initializing Quadratic Sieve: manages factor base generation, Knuth-Schroeppel multiplier selection, thread spawning, and result collection.

nodes.name: Siqs
nodes.summary: Extends Relation to orchestrate the complete SIQS factorization process: setup, factor base with Knuth-Schroeppel multiplier, sieving threads, and linear algebra.

nodes.name: factor
nodes.summary: Main SIQS factor method: configures parameters, spawns sieve threads, waits for sufficient congruences, then runs linear algebra to extract the factor.

nodes.name: Setup
nodes.summary: Computes SIQS startup data: finds optimal Knuth-Schroeppel multiplier, generates factor base with quadratic residues, sets sieve thresholds and polynomial parameters.
Utility class with static methods for SIQS algorithm including binary search, Jacobi symbol, modular inverse, SQUFOF factoring, and probabilistic primality testing

nodes.name: SQUFOF
nodes.summary: SQUFOF (Square Form Factorization) algorithm with multiplier 3: cycles forward to find square forms, then backward to extract factors of small integers.

nodes.name: isProbablePrime
nodes.summary: Montgomery multiplication-based probabilistic primality test checking if 2^value mod value == 2 for odd values, using 31-bit limb arithmetic.

nodes.name: ConvertBase.java
nodes.summary: Encapsulates a base-conversion operation for the calculator, validating that the base falls within the range 2 to 36.

nodes.name: ConvertBase
nodes.summary: Implements the Operation interface to represent a base conversion request, storing the target base and validating its range.

nodes.name: Deque.java
nodes.summary: A dynamic double-ended queue (deque) that grows as needed, supporting add/remove/get operations at both front and back.

nodes.name: Deque
nodes.summary: Circular array-based deque that doubles its capacity when full, providing O(1) amortized add/remove at both ends.

nodes.name: EmptyDequeException.java
nodes.summary: A simple exception class thrown when attempting to access an element in an empty Deque.

nodes.name: EmptyDequeException
nodes.summary: Extends Exception to signal that a Deque access was attempted while the Deque is empty.

Core Model interface in the calculator MVC architecture. Defines the calculator contract with two methods: doOperation(Operation, String) for performing stack operations and changeSettings(Object, String) for mutable settings like sticky bases. Implemented by largemodel/CalculatorImpl.
nodes.name: Calculator.java

nodes.summary: Core View interface in the calculator MVC architecture. Defines the user interface contract with methods: getInput() for reading user input, insert(String) for adding text to the display, setOutput(String, int) for showing results with a radix, setBusy(boolean) for cursor feedback, and showError(Throwable) for error display. Implemented by DefaultUI.
nodes.name: CalculatorUI.java

nodes.summary: Default Swing-based user interface implementing CalculatorUI for an RPN integer calculator. Constructs a JFrame with a numeric display (NumericDocument), radix combo box (2-36), a 6x4 grid of operation/digit buttons, and a menu bar with Edit (cut/copy/paste/select-all) and Options (sticky bases). Dynamically loads operation classes via reflection from the model package. Contains 7 inner package-private classes: ButtonAction (operation dispatch), TextButtonAction (digit entry), SelectAllAction, HomeAction, EndAction (caret navigation), BaseListener (radix change), and SetSticky (sticky base toggle). Supports all radices 2-36 and base conversion.
nodes.name: DefaultUI.java

nodes.summary: A PlainDocument subclass for storing arbitrarily large integers in arbitrary bases 2-36. Filters character input to accept only valid digits for the current radix. Tracks modification state via isModified() to distinguish user input from programmatic updates. Preserves a leading minus sign for negative numbers and overwrites document content on first user edit for clean input.
nodes.name: NumericDocument.java

nodes.summary: EncodedOperation for sign negation. Returns the negation of a single LargeInteger operand via operands[0].negate(). Includes a static utility method ChSignBigNbr for low-level two's complement negation on int arrays representing big integers.
nodes.name: ChangeSigns.java

nodes.summary: EncodedOperation for remainder/modulo. Takes two LargeInteger operands and returns operands[0].divide(operands[1])[1] (the remainder). Throws ArithmeticException on division by zero. Includes a static utility method RemDivBigNbrByLong for low-level remainder computation on int arrays using modular arithmetic with 2^31 base.
nodes.name: Remainder.java

nodes.summary: EncodedOperation for subtraction. Takes two LargeInteger operands and returns operands[0].subtract(operands[1]). Includes two static utility methods: SubtractBigNbr for 31-bit array subtraction and SubtractBigNbr32 for 32-bit array subtraction, both using carry propagation.

nodes.summary: Perfect power detection for factoring. Uses a probabilistic filter with primes of the form 2310x+1 to eliminate impossible exponents (2,3,5,7,11), then an Eratosthenes-sieve-based filter over all primes up to 2*maxExpon+3. For remaining candidates, computes the integer k-th root via Newton iteration and checks if root^Exponent == N. Uses log2 approximation for initial root estimate.

Check() uses modular residue filters and log approximation to find candidate exponents. ProcessExponent computes integer k-th roots of N+1 and N-1 via Newton iteration. Cunningham() inserts known primitive factors and Aurifeuillian factors.

layers.name: Utilities
layers.description: Foundation math utilities providing FFT, NTT, prime sieving (Zeef), timing, and bit-reversal operations. No internal project dependencies; imported by Big Integer Arithmetic and primality test modules.

layers.name: Big Integer Arithmetic
layers.description: Custom arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic library. Provides LargeInteger (schoolbook/FFT/NTT multiplication), MontgomeryInteger (Montgomery modular multiplication with Karatsuba), ECMBigInteger (totient, Moebius, Aurifeuillian factors), AprtCleInteger (APR-CL primality proving with Jacobi sums), FactorInteger (factorization result tracking), and StaticFunctions (31/32-bit digit conversion and modular helpers). Depends on utilities layer for FFT/NTT.

layers.name: ECM Support Libraries
layers.description: Support libraries for the Elliptic Curve Method and general primality verification. Contains binary GCD and modular inverse (ecm.BigIntegers), special-form factoring detection (Fibonacci, Lucas, perfect power, Cunningham numbers via ecm.Checks), and APR-CL primality proving with Lucas-Lehmer Mersenne testing (ecm.PrimeTest). Depends on Big Integers layer.

layers.name: Factorization Algorithms
layers.description: Core prime factorization algorithm implementations. Includes Classical trial division, Lehman's algorithm (threaded), the Elliptic Curve Method (ECM with steps 0-2 using Montgomery curves and Lucas chains), and the Self-Initializing Quadratic Sieve (SIQS with polynomial generation, sieving, partial relation matching, Block Lanczos linear algebra over GF(2), and SQUFOF). SIQS classes form an inheritance chain: FirstPolynomial -> Sieve, Maths -> Matrix -> Relation -> Siqs. Depends on Big Integers and ECM Support layers.

layers.name: Gazman Quadratic Sieve
layers.description: Standalone independent Quadratic Sieve implementation under the com.gazman package. Contains its own math utilities (MathUtils with Tonelli-Shanks, SqrRoot), sieving engine (QuadraticSieve, BigPrimesList, VectorData, Logger), GF(2) matrix solver (BitMatrix, VectorsShrinker), and wheel-based sieve iteration (Wheel). Fully self-contained with no imports from other project packages.

layers.name: RPN Calculator
layers.description: Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) integer calculator with Swing GUI (MVC architecture). The javamodel sub-package provides operations using standard Java integers; the largemodel sub-package reimplements the same operations using the custom LargeInteger class for arbitrary precision. Core interfaces: Calculator (model), CalculatorUI (view), and concrete implementations DefaultUI (Swing), with Operation and EncodedOperation abstractions. Includes Deque data structure, NumericDocument input filter, and ConvertBase. Depends on Big Integers layer (largemodel uses LargeInteger).

layers.name: Application Infrastructure
layers.description: Top-level application shell and project infrastructure. Contains the main Swing GUI (Factorzations.GUI) with embedded RPN calculator display, factorization orchestration, and special-form check invocations. Also includes NetBeans IDE project configuration (nbproject/), Ant build scripts (build.xml), JAR manifest, BlueJ top-level package metadata, CHANGELOG, .understand-anything ignore rules, JUnit test driver, and macOS .DS_Store artifact. The GUI is the application main class and depends on all other layers.

tour.title: Project Overview and Build Configuration
tour.description: Begin with the project README and changelog to understand the factorization algorithms implemented (ECM, SIQS, Lehman, Classical). NetBeans/Ant build configuration defines Factorzations.GUI as the main class targeting Java 11. BlueJ package descriptors reveal the 5 sub-packages: calculator, BigIntegers, Factorzations, utilities, and ecm.

tour.title: Application Entry Point and Simple Factorizers
tour.description: The main GUI (Factorzations.GUI.java) provides the Swing interface for entering numbers and invoking factorization algorithms. Classical.java performs trial division up to sqrt(N). Lehman.java implements Lehman's perfect-square detection algorithm as a concurrent Thread. These are the first algorithms tried before escalating to ECM/SIQS.

tour.title: Big Integer Arithmetic Foundation
tour.description: All factorization algorithms depend on arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic. LargeInteger provides core operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide, pow) with FFT/NTT-based multiplication. MontgomeryInteger extends it with REDC modular multiplication and optional Karatsuba. StaticFunctions bridges java.math.BigInteger with internal 31-bit digit arrays.

tour.title: APR-CL Primality Proving and ECM Support Infrastructure
tour.description: Before factoring, numbers are tested for primality. The APR-CL deterministic primality prover (AprtCleInteger, AprtCle, AprtCleFinal) uses Jacobi sum evaluation and Montgomery arithmetic with precomputed tables in AprtCleVariable. ECM support utilities provide binary GCD (GCD.java), modular inverse via extended binary GCD (ModInv.java), and Lucas/Fibonacci/Power sequence checks for early factor detection.

tour.title: ECM (Elliptic Curve Method) Factorization
tour.description: ECM.java orchestrates the elliptic curve method through a class hierarchy: ecmStep0 initializes Montgomery curve parameters (A, X:Z), ecmStep1 performs scalar multiplication using Montgomery's ladder with Lucas chains (PRAC algorithm), and ecmStep2 uses baby-step-giant-step improved standard continuation with sieving. ECM falls back to SIQS for numbers in the 30-90 digit range.

tour.title: SIQS (Self-Initializing Quadratic Sieve)
tour.description: Siqs.java orchestrates the full SIQS pipeline: Knuth-Schroeppel multiplier selection, factor base generation, spawning Sieve threads that evaluate polynomial sets (FirstPolynomial), detect smooth/partial relations (Relation.java), and perform trial division. The class hierarchy runs Siqs -> Relation -> Matrix -> Maths, each adding capability.

tour.title: SIQS Linear Algebra: Block Lanczos over GF(2)
tour.description: After collecting enough smooth relations, Maths.java orchestrates singleton erasure and invokes Matrix.java which implements the Block Lanczos algorithm (block size 32) over GF(2) to find nullspace vectors. These linear dependencies yield congruence-of-squares solutions, tested via GCD to extract non-trivial factors.

tour.title: Gazman Quadratic Sieve (Independent QS Implementation)
tour.description: An independent quadratic sieve implementation under com.gazman provides an alternative QS approach. QuadraticSieve.java uses wheel-based sieving (Wheel.java with Tonelli-Shanks from MathUtils), collects B-smooth vectors, and solves via Gaussian elimination over GF(2) using BitMatrix. Includes its own prime base generation and vector shrinking utilities.

tour.title: RPN Calculator (MVC Architecture)
tour.description: The RPN calculator follows a clean MVC pattern: Calculator (model interface), CalculatorUI (view interface), DefaultUI (Swing implementation), and two CalculatorImpl variants (javamodel for BigInteger, largemodel for LargeInteger). Operations are encapsulated as EncodedOperation implementations (Add, Multiply, Power, etc.) using reflection-based dynamic loading. Supports bases 2-36 and arbitrary-precision arithmetic via LargeInteger.

tour.title: Test Suite and Utility Infrastructure
tour.description: The JUnit test (test/test/JUnitTest.java) exercises core algorithms: ECM factorization, APR-CL primality proving, GCD/modular inverse, Fibonacci/Lucas checks, LargeInteger arithmetic, and the Gazman QS BitMatrix solver. Utility classes (FFT, NTT, Zeef sieve, Timer) underpin LargeInteger's fast multiplication and primality testing.
